messages:
Priya: Kickoff: CloudHarbor x VaultBridge co-launch. Narrow scope: 30min live demo + 1 long-form integration post for marketplace + 1 short how-to blog. Proposed date: May 12 10:00am PT.

Ben: Love it. Target audience = infra/platform engs. Key narrative: "plug-and-play inference at lower TCO" with a short technical appendix.

Diego: Marketplace listing needs: partner logo (SVG), 2 screenshots, 150-word blurb, pricing bullets, and an icon. Who's owning assets?

Claire: I can do screenshots + hero banner. Need demo environment access by next Tue to capture flow. Preferred sizes: 1200x600 for hero, 560x315 for screenshot.

Priya: Claire please take the lead on creative. Ben and Diego will send demo creds to design-private channel.

Nia: Legal note: any customer quotes or metrics must have written approval. For bench metrics we need the partner to sign an approved data disclosure. No raw IP.

Diego: CloudHarbor said yes to a sanitized perf table and a two-line blurb. I'll get their sign-off by Fri COB.

Ben: Events ops: Registration -> HubSpot form. Route inbound leads to SFDC queue "Marketplace/CloudHarbor" and tag with `utm_campaign=ch-vb-may12` + `source=partner_marketplace`. CTA: "Get the integration guide" (form trigger).

Priya: UTM sample to use in partner social posts and email: `?utm_source=cloudharbor&utm_medium=partner_webinar&utm_campaign=ch-vb-may12`. Please copy exact string.

Claire: Quick brand Q: does CloudHarbor require co-brand checkout approved? I can send a mock to their PM for sign-off.

Diego: yes, they want co-branded header but no BlueButton CTA on their site. We'll keep single CTA that points to our landing.

Priya: Agenda for the live: 5m intros, 15m demo (VaultBridge plug-in + deployment pattern), 7m benchmark highlights, 3m partner perspective, 5m Q&A. Keep slides to 6-8.

Ben: Can we include a one-click reproducible recipe in the follow-up email (script + docker compose)? Good for developer conversion.

Claire: On the landing we'll add a code tab and commands snippet. I need the minimal reproducible steps by Wed.

Priya: Assignments: Ben: HubSpot form + follow-up email template (due Wed). Diego: partner sign-offs + SFDC routing (due Fri). Claire: creatives + screenshots (need access Tue). Nia: legal approval flow (monitor).

Nia: I'll prepare a short approval checklist for partner metrics: source, redaction level, disclosure language. Share it with Diego.

Ben: Recording and transcript: CalendarBot, please set to auto-record and auto-transcribe.

CalendarBot: Recording scheduled for 2026-05-12T17:00:00Z. Auto-transcribe ON. Uploads to gdrive/marketing/partners/cloudharbor-vaultbridge.

Priya: Promotion plan: 2 partner co-tweets, 1 joint blog post on marketplaces, 1 LinkedIn long post from CloudHarbor PM. Organic email to 12k list + partner's 3k list. Need boomerang emails 24h and 72h after.

Diego: Partner comms: I'll feed them the timeline and the copy deck. Also confirm if CloudHarbor wants a headshot of our speaker.

Claire: I'll add a speaker headshot slot on the hero. Send me headshots to #design-uploads.

Ben: KPI targets: 600 registrants, 120 live attendees, 30 MQLs. Track CTRs on the download link for the integration guide.

Priya: Rehearsal: run-through May 10 9:00am PT. Ajenda will be shared 48h prior. Everyone please be present who is speaking.

Diego: I'll post the partner-approved blurb once I have it. Expect it Fri morning.

Priya: Thanks all. I'll post the master checkbox and timeline in this thread. Ping me for any blockers. :rocket:
